title: T106 (Tinyana) PNC - Ra'ui Le-Harheir be-Divrei Torah Bi-She'as Zivug
hebrewTitle: ראוי להרהר בדברי תורה בשעת זיווג
author: Pettek Nanach

beginner.en: **Ra'ui le-harheir be-divrei Torah bi-she'as zivug** (see Zoihar Metzora 56, ve-Mikdash Melech sham). It is *fitting to harheir in divrei Torah at the time of the zivug*. **Ve-af-al-pi-chein yachoil le-holid banim, af-al-pi she-machshavtoi tih'yeh devuka az be-hirhurei Torah.** *And one can still have children* — even though one's machshavah at that moment is *bound up in hirhurei Torah*. The kabbalistic concern that the *mind being on something else* might harm the *zera* is here pushed back: *Toirah is not a distraction; her hirhur is the very kedushah of the moment*. **Ve-toiv me'oid le-hargil atzmoi be-chach.** *Very good to habituate oneself in this.*

intermediate.en: **Yesoid hilkhah-tovaa**: ra'ui le-harheir be-divrei Torah bi-she'as zivug (זוה"ק מצורע נו ובמק"מ). *Af-al-pi-chein yachoil le-holid banim*. *Toiv me'oid le-hargil atzmoi*.

scholarly.he: [T2:106א] ראוי להרהר בד"ת בשעת זיווג (זוה"ק מצורע נו ובמק"מ); ואע"פ כן יכול להוליד בנים. טוב להרגיל.
